notes.title: 📢 Amazing news for Resistance 204X! We finally…
notes.content:
We finally received funding to continue with the game development! A lot of you have been waiting patiently for any news so let me show you what to expect.

[h3][b]If you’re new here…[/b][/h3]
… or need me to refresh your memory: Resistance 204X is a fast-paced 2D fighting game that takes a twist on the traditional fighting game formula and puts it into a blending machine with Nidhogg and Footsies. Your objective: Fight strategically, disrupt your opponent with powerful combos and reach the other end of the stage. It’s easy to learn, but hard to master!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/8bb6810f9a671da65ca4944b9bd6606c4c0be4ed.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What has been going on? Let’s quickly catch-up:[/b][/h3]
After quite a long time of solo-developing Resistance, Julio founded Yaga Studio in early 2024 together with Georg and Katharina! I, Lola, recently joined the team to help spread the word about Resistance. The team now consists of a multicultural mix of awesome people, who are excited to finally bring the vision for Resistance 204X to life, woo-hoo!

[h3][b]How to support the Resistance and stay up to date:[/b][/h3]

[b]Wishlist![/b]
Wishlisting the game is an easy and super helpful way to support the development. So if you haven’t done it already and are excited for the game, we appreciate your wishlist a ton!! <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829140/Resistance_204X/

[b]Join the community![/b]
Hop over onto our [url=https://discord.gg/kYxSgY5vCp]Discord server[/url] to be the first one to get notified about exclusive playtests, teasers, updates, events & much more. Or simply connect with us and other players, give feedback and ask any burning questions!

[b]Play the demo![/b]
We are currently starting to work on adding and improving content for future demos, so we can hook you up with amazing new moves and characters. In the meantime you can check out our demo on Steam and leave a review, to let us know what you think!
(Keep in mind that the demo is currently only available in English. We are planning on translating the game in the future though!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/0ba7c98352e8ca56a954fbd3f26ab8f1b40db562.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Last but not least - a teaser on what’s coming:[/b][/h3]
We’ll give you more info about the changes and content that you’re gonna see in the coming months, but get ready for:
🤖 Many exciting new characters
💬 Storymode
🎮 Exclusive playtest opportunities
🙌 Online and on-site events
& of course thick vibes!! ✌️💥

That’s all for now! Spread the word, tell a friend and see you around!
Lola

notes.title: Free Open Beta is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZhdchZqSQN8;full][/previewyoutube]
Resistance 204X open beta is finally available and is packed with exciting features and updates!

[h1]New character: Slice[/h1]
First up, we've got a new big and strong playable character called "Slice". He's a force to be reckoned with, and you'll definitely want to try him out in battle. 

[h1]New terrains[/h1]
We've also added new terrains to the game, giving you even more options for your battles.

[h1]Twitch chat integration[/h1]
But wait, there's more! With our Twitch chat integration, Twitch viewers can mess with the streamer's game. Imagine the chaos that could ensue as the chat throws obstacles in the streamer's way or gives the opponent a sudden power boost.

[h1]Custom player names[/h1]
Finally, we're thrilled to announce that you can now add custom player names. This means you can truly make the game your own and show off your skills with your personalized username.

[h1]Join the Resistance[/h1]
Join the Resistance and take your fighting skills to the next level with Resistance 204X open beta. 

[b]Add to your wishlist[/b] and [b]Request access[/b] to get the free beta!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383592/98391e55f5a636b4f6d62d54f7505f1d5c47b682.png[/img]

notes.title: The beta is just about to be done!
notes.content:
The beta is just about to be done!
Making juicy nice and responsive menus it's a big task. 
A lot of details needed to be covered but it's finally done and working nicely.

New implementations:
[list]
[*] A short cinematic introduction showing the lore of the game
[*] Home Menu including settings, profile, PvP, stage selection, etc...
[*] Joystick automatic detection and menu support
[*] Music and sound effects for all the above
[/list]
Here you can check out a small preview
[previewyoutube=ev05O8GOZF8;full][/previewyoutube]
